name: Cengage UI Style Guide
des: A foundational design system and living documentation platform for Cengage Learning. Built on a customized Bootstrap framework, it standardizes responsive layouts, typography, and interactive UI components to enforce accessible, cohesive development across enterprise educational platforms.
mission: Architect a scalable UI component library and establish living documentation to drive design consistency and streamline front-end development workflows.
technology: HTML5, CSS3, LESS, Bootstrap, JavaScript, jQuery, Font Awesome, Responsive Design

name: Oracle Workbench
des: An AngularJS single-page application (SPA) engineered to manage and document Oracle-based content cartridges across enterprise educational platforms. The dashboard streamlines content workflows by providing dynamic search, advanced filtering, and interactive modal previews for National Geographic, Cengage, and Nelson projects.
mission: Architect an interactive documentation dashboard to centralize UI system analysis and streamline content management workflows for multi-client platforms.
technology: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, AngularJS, Bootstrap, ngRoute, ngResource, jQuery, Responsive Design

name: Cross CHX Dashboard
des: A data-intensive healthcare analytics SPA engineered for clinical data analysis. It integrates complex D3.js visualizations, geographic mapping, and comprehensive patient-physician profiles into a unified interface to streamline cardiology analytics and demographic reporting.
mission: Architect a responsive data visualization dashboard that synthesizes complex healthcare metrics into actionable, scalable UI components.
technology: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, AngularJS, D3.js, ngRoute, ngResource, Polymer, Google Maps, Material Icons, Responsive Design
